Danny (Dennis) Citrinowicz ,داني سيترينوفيتش (@citrinowicz)

It’s hard to overstate how implausible this plan was.
 
The idea that an air campaign could somehow pave the way for Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, a figure deeply despised by Khamenei and long marginalized by the regime, to return to power in Iran was detached from political reality from the start. Ahmadinejad never had meaningful backing from the Revolutionary Guards, and there was never a credible path for him to seize control of the sta

Some Iranians are silent about the Minab school bombing by the US. Some Iranians are silent about the January massacre of protesters by security forces. 

Both involved the loss of human life. Both should be condemned...

I was literally playing this song for someone the other week 🤣


Mark Mazzetti (@MarkMazzettiNYT)

For all you kids out there, Ahmadinejad was somebody once:

I'm still thinking about what happened to Ahmadinejad. I heard a rumor from some folks that he met with Israelis in a neighboring country and was put under house arrest for that reason. 😳


Holly Dagres (@hdagres)

This was a wild read: "Ahmadinejad’s associates say the strike was in effect a jailbreak operation that freed the former president from regime control... regime elements immediately suspected that he had been spirited away to take part in a coup."
